scope: OULAD preliminary experiments, not full paper replication

confirmation.note: Retrospective independent-season check. Target students exclude all exploration IDs. Not a prospectively later cohort.

budget_unit: unique source calibration student IDs, nested and shared across times/methods; actual stage counts reported
calibration_budget_note: No extra source base-validation labels used for calibrator selection. Simple calibrators use all budget IDs; DFMC uses 70/30 fit/validation, matching author training scheme; no full-budget refit. All methods observe identical calibration label budget.
target_population: Registered by end of t and not unregistered by t; ambiguous withdrawn dates excluded; target IDs seen in full corresponding 2013 source removed
features: day 0..t VLE; available nonbanked submissions <=t; no marks, withdrawal dates, final labels, student IDs as inputs; scheduled deadlines assumed known at start
groups: course, progress_state and course x progress_state indicators; no protected attributes
exploratory_failure_rule: Brier harm >0.002 versus Platt in at least 4/5 seeds, evaluated at fixed base/time/budget/course; descriptive screening, no multiplicity-adjusted claim
small_group_report_rule: Report n and positive/negative counts; flag n<50 or fewer than10 per class as unstable
improvement_policy: After exploration, select one targeted mechanism, record a separate frozen decision, then evaluate both seasons including untouched confirmation performance. Do not claim novelty or success if unsupported.
uncertainty: Seeds are computational repeats; paired bootstrap clusters on student IDs, preserves repeated course/time predictions; confirmation CIs conditional on these three courses.
